properties.description: Marine feeder bluff observation point looking north-northwest toward Indianola shoreline over Puget Sound

geology.strata: Pleistocene Vashon Glacial Drift, unconsolidated advance outwash sand and gravel over dense Lawton clay/silt
geology.landform: Active marine feeder bluff escarpment, 20-30 meters vertical relief, subject to subaerial erosion and shallow colluvial ravelling
geology.intertidal_fringe: Cobble, pebble, and coarse sand littoral depositional shelf with drift logs along the high-tide wrack line

botany.canopy: Pseudotsuga menziesii (Douglas-fir), Thuja plicata (Western Redcedar), Acer macrophyllum (Bigleaf Maple), Alnus rubra (Red Alder)
botany.understory: Polystichum munitum (Sword fern), Gaultheria shallon (Salal), Rubus spectabilis (Salmonberry), invasive Hedera helix patches

structures.name: Bluff-crest custom timber residence
structures.roof_type: Asymmetric low-pitch gabled and shed rooflines, slate-gray composite asphalt shingles
structures.facade: Natural weathered western red cedar horizontal bevel siding, floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass facing sound, broad cantilevered redwood view deck

structures.name: Adjacent coastal contemporary home
structures.roof_type: Cross-gabled roof, metal standing seam dark charcoal
structures.facade: Painted hardie-plank board and batten, expansive seaward glazing
